**Email from ParcelNorth**

Subject: Address confirmation needed for order 5582

Dear Mr. Hale,

Your order left our distribution center yesterday. [1] This morning, the carrier reported that the delivery address is missing a suite number. [2] Please reply with the suite number before 3 P.M. today. [3] Once we receive it, we will update the carrier immediately and send you a revised delivery estimate. [4]

Thank you,
ParcelNorth Service Team

To request approval for a change of carrier
To provide a confirmed delivery estimate

groups.passage:
**Manufacturer installs rooftop solar array**

Rennett Tools has completed a 420-panel solar installation on its assembly plant. The company expects the array to supply about 22 percent of the building’s annual electricity use. Panels were placed only on the newer east roof because engineers determined that the west roof will need resurfacing within two years.

During construction, the installer scheduled crane work before the morning shift to avoid blocking the employee parking entrance. Rennett also replaced older lighting controls in the assembly area while electricians were already on site.

The company will compare monthly electricity purchases with production volume for a full year before deciding whether to add panels above its warehouse.

questions.question_text: What percentage of annual electricity use may the solar array supply?
The word “array” is closest in meaning to
Why were no panels installed on the west roof?

options.text: It is above the employee parking lot.
That roof will need resurfacing soon.

questions.question_text: Why did Rennett replace lighting controls during the solar project?

options.text: Electricians were already working on site.
The solar panels require brighter indoor lights.
The west roof project was canceled permanently.

**PrintPro copier lease rates**

Model L20: 25 pages/minute, $145/month, 2,000 pages included
Model M40: 40 pages/minute, $210/month, 4,000 pages included
Model X55: 55 pages/minute, $295/month, 7,000 pages included

We average about 3,500 printed pages a month, and our current copier is too slow for the Monday invoice run. A speed near 40 pages per minute is sufficient.
